title: Treaty Application Build Target
description: Build a Treaty application with Rspack and automatic Module Federation.

entry.description: The application entry point, relative to the workspace root (e.g. `src/main.ts`).

outputPath.description: Directory the compiled federated bundle is written to, relative to the workspace root.

name.description: This app's Module Federation container/library name. Defaults to the project name.

remotes.description: Remotes this app consumes, keyed by the local alias used in dynamic imports; the value is the remote entry URL.

exposes.description: Modules this app exposes to other apps, keyed by public import path (e.g. `./Widget`).

optimization.description: Produce a minified, content-hashed production build.
